items.title: Melania Trump says ceasefire has expanded as it takes effect around Russian-occupied city of Oleshky
items.brief: A localized ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine around the occupied city of Oleshky that first lady Melania Trump helped to broker has now gone into effect, officials on both sides said Tuesday.

items.title: Susan Saint James, Emmy-winning actor of ‘McMillan & Wife’ and ‘Kate & Allie,’ dies at 80
items.brief: Susan Saint James, who costarred with Rock Hudson in the 1970s TV crime series “McMillan & Wife” and later costarred with Jane Curtin in the sitcom “Kate & Allie” in the 1980s, has died.

items.title: King Charles heads to Caribbean as calls grow for slavery apology
items.brief: Britain’s King Charles III will begin a tour of the Caribbean Tuesday as pressure mounts on Britain to apologize and pay reparations for its role in the slave trade.

items.title: Gas under Trump 2.0 is now more expensive than it was under Biden
